title: Settlement
description: The final outcome of one market — settled for every observed eligible market, not only placed bets, so unbet market families remain researchable. hypothetical returns are price-dependent, never reduced to a bare win/loss count.

outcome.description: Underlying game/market fact the settlement was derived from, e.g. 'away_won_f5'

settlementStatus.description: UNAVAILABLE/SETTLEMENT_UNRESOLVED must carry a reason; never silently guessed

result.description: Result of the YES side of this market, independent of whether anyone bet it

hypotheticalReturnsByCheckpoint.description: Price-dependent hypothetical $1-stake return at each recorded checkpoint quote, for research into unbet markets

hypotheticalYesReturn.description: (1 - yesPrice)/yesPrice on a win, -1 on a loss, 0 on a push/void, per $1 staked on YES

betId.description: Set when a real bet exists on this market

realizedReturn.description: Actual dollar return — only ever populated when betId is set
